# appdynamics_roles (Data Source)

Lists the RBAC roles in the current AppDynamics account.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "appdynamics_roles" "all" {}

output "role_names" {
  value = { for r in data.appdynamics_roles.all.roles : r.id => r.name }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->

- `roles` (Attributes List) The roles in the account. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--roles))
